source: GIZ / India Agrivoltaics Alliance, Agrivoltaics in India: Overview of Projects (IGCA, 2025)

sites.name: Adarsh Jeevan Solar Farm
sites.crops: Capsicum, tomato, garlic, onion, mustard, wheat, maize, spinach, strawberries, lettuce, broccoli, baby corn
specs: Farmer income enhancement, PM-KUSUM-A, commercial and research
Farmers Mr. Anand Jain and Mrs. Manoj Jain
Technical: Khare Energy. Agricultural: open for partnership
Grid export under PM-KUSUM-A at ₹3.07/kWh, 25-year PPA with the MP government
Manual, water based; water reused for farming
Rainwater harvesting, drip and sprinkler irrigation
Intercropping and rotation across rabi, kharif and zaid; mulching; seasonal crops and long-term fruit plantation
₹9.5 Cr per 2 MW; 70% bank loan, 30% farmer equity; IRR over 15%, payback 7–8 years
₹1.1–1.2 Cr/year per 2 MW from power and ₹10–12 lakh/year per 2 MW from crops
sites.about: Flagship agrivoltaics farm under PM-KUSUM-A combining elevated solar generation with multi-crop farming on Khare Energy's RCC structure. Recognised by GIZ, EY and IARI.

photos.cap: Crops grown at the 4.5 MW plant
Panel structures of the 4.5 MW plant

sites.name: Talf Solar 4.25 MW agrivoltaics project
sites.crops: Grain crops for now; other options being explored with GIZ
specs: Supply solar power to non-profit institutions (Hindu College, Miranda House, Hansraj College, St. Stephen's College) while farmers keep farming the land
Grid export, for use by non-profit educational institutions
Very little knowledge of which crops work best under agrivoltaics; support from agencies and universities would be welcome
sites.about: Conceived in 2022; implementation took longer than expected because of policy uncertainty. Talf invested in spaced-out, high-rise structures and glass-backed panels to improve crop yields.

sites.name: Cochin International Airport (CIAL)
sites.crops: Over 20 vegetables incl. yam, long yard bean, drumstick, ginger, turmeric, cabbage, cauliflower, gourds, cucumber, eggplant, tomato, pumpkin, okra
specs: PPA with Kerala State Electricity Board; debt from Deutsche Bank
265 Wp Renesola polycrystalline; ABB 1 MW central inverters
Manual with water about twice a month; water reused for crops
Formerly barren land improved with cow manure; fully organic; 60–80 t/year produce
sites.about: The largest of the airport's eight solar plants covers 45 acres, of which about 20 acres were under agrivoltaic farming by Dec 2021. Produce is sold directly to consumers and passengers.

photos.cap: Agrivoltaics plant at Cochin Airport (Credit: CIAL)
Elephant foot yam under the panels (Credit: CIAL)

sites.name: Sunmaster Agri PV Plant Mundela
sites.crops: Finger, foxtail and kodo millet, broccoli, cauliflower, asparagus, French beans, potato, mushroom, cherry tomato, onion, spinach, kale, lettuce, carrot, beet, radish, snow peas
specs: Integrate solar with e-mobility next to the DTC EV bus depot; raise open area by 50% to widen cropping
Local consumption and export to the DTC bus depot
Grid integration and connectivity were the main challenge
sites.about: Promotes clean energy alongside multi-cropping that raises local farmers' income.

sites.name: SunMaster APV
sites.crops: Brinjal, lettuce, spinach, okra, potato, tomato, bottle gourd, fenugreek, coriander, cucumber; mango, turmeric, pomegranate
specs: Telescopic water brush and manual dry cleaning
sites.about: Research field with vegetables under a 4.3 m overhead array.

photos.cap: Below-panel view of the SunMaster APV plant (Credit: SunMaster)

sites.name: Sunmaster Agri PV Plant Issapur Dhasa 2
sites.crops: Finger, foxtail and kodo millet, broccoli, cauliflower, asparagus, French beans, potato, mushroom
specs: Research and demonstration with bifacial panels; 22% more open area to multiply farmer income
Water/dry, weekly; robotic cleaning later cut this to twice a month
Millets grow well in light to moderate shade alongside seasonal vegetables
sites.about: Built to cut farmers' and businesses' energy costs and encourage sustainable farming. Includes a cow shed under the array.

sites.name: Sunmaster Agri PV Plant Qutabgarh
sites.crops: Spinach, coriander, fenugreek, lettuce, carrot, turnip, sweet potato, beetroot, ginger, radish, onion
specs: Research, dual land use, farmer income, last-mile energy
High TDS and salinity in the water are unfavourable for crops and must be managed
sites.about: A lower tilt was chosen to maximise generation and cope with saline water.

sites.name: Talf Solar 2.25 MW agrivoltaics project
sites.crops: Grain crops for now; other options being explored with GIZ
specs: Supply solar power to hospitals and schools while farmers keep farming
Grid export, for hospitals and schools
Elevated with extra spacing and single-axis tracker
Little knowledge of which crops balance plant and farm needs
sites.about: Conceived in 2021; delayed by policy uncertainty.

sites.name: Indra Solar Farm
sites.crops: Wheat, barley, sorghum, mustard, groundnut, green gram; Napier grass; tomato, potato, brinjal, chilli, spinach
specs: Farmer income enhancement, PM-KUSUM-A, commercial and research
Grid export under PM-KUSUM-A at ₹3.07/kWh, 25-year PPA
Elevated RCC structure; shade-net structure; semi-elevated for goat grazing
Proposed as a new test block
Rainwater harvesting, drip, sprinkler and flood irrigation
₹9.5 Cr; 70% bank loan, 30% farmer equity; IRR over 15%, payback 7–8 years
Wheat yield parity with open field and 25% water savings (under expert review)
sites.about: Madhya Pradesh's first agrivoltaics plant: a 16-acre live laboratory with 3 module types, 4 inverter technologies and 5 structure designs, combined with crops, horticulture and livestock.

photos.cap: Aerial view of Indra Solar Farm
Crops grown at Indra Solar Farm

sites.name: Agrivoltaics plant near Parbhani
sites.dev: SunSeed APV Pvt. Ltd. and GIZ
sites.design: Test field: elevated shadehouse, below/interspace, interspace
sites.crops: Cherry tomato, capsicum, cucumber, betel leaf, turmeric, ginger, basil, spinach, methi, coriander, mint, flowers, melons
specs: Kanoda Energy Systems and SunSeed APV
Jai Hind Agro Farm Management; rotational, residue-free cultivation since Jan 2023
Land graded for water harvesting; drip irrigation with soil-moisture sensors
Elevated with shadehouse; polycrystalline; 3.75 m, 11° tilt, 5.64 m pitch; robotic dry cleaning; foggers and drip
Below and interspace; mono PERC; 1.75 m, 11°, pitch 10 m and 7.5 m
Interspace; bifacial PERC; 1.25 m, 11°, pitch 10 m; watermelon
sites.about: Part of a larger 50 MW solar project in Marathwada, with four APV designs and an open control plot. A 6,000 m² elevated section carries a reflective shade-net house for trellised vegetables.

photos.cap: Soil preparation at section III (Credit: GIZ)
Soil preparation at elevated section I (Credit: GIZ)
Visitors examine capsicum at section I (Credit: GIZ)

sites.name: Sunmaster Agri PV Plant Surakpur
sites.crops: Spinach, coriander, fenugreek, lettuce, carrot, turnip, sweet potato, ginger, radish, onion
specs: Mono PERC cut-cell bifacial n-type TOPCon
Grid integration, availability of electric meters, and limited land
sites.about: Aims to show village-level agrivoltaics for energy independence.

sites.name: GroSolar APV
sites.crops: Geranium, guava, lemongrass; sheep grazing
specs: 30,300 Panasonic Anchor 330 W polycrystalline (made in India)
Sheep rearing is a main activity; power also used by nearby villages and farms
sites.about: Interspace geranium, guava and lemongrass with sheep grazing under low-mounted panels.

photos.cap: Sheep grazing under the panels (Credit: GroSolar)

sites.name: GIPCL Amrol Distributed Solar Power Project
sites.crops: Kharif: groundnut, soybean, pearl millet, cotton, pulses, maize; rabi: chickpea, wheat, mustard, lucerne, vegetables; summer: sesame, fodder
specs: ₹3.44/kWh (2019); fed into an 11 kV rural feeder; ₹6 Cr/MWp
1–3 m; module gaps of 0, 100 and 250 mm to test shade patterns
Every 10 days with a telescopic cloth; about 3 L/module; 200,000 L/MWp/yr
Loamy sand; tractors can pass between and partly below panels
Vastan scale model with Navsari Agricultural University (separate marker)
sites.about: Anand Agricultural University runs the farming side. Varying gaps between modules and arrays test the effect of different shade patterns on crops.

photos.cap: Aerial view of the Amrol plant (Credit: GIPCL)

sites.name: GIPCL Vastan plant
sites.crops: Vegetables and field crops (harvest shown)
specs: Scale model of GIPCL's Amrol plant, listed under project 13 in the report
sites.about: GIPCL built and operates this plant with Navsari Agricultural University.

photos.cap: View of GIPCL's Vastan plant (Credit: GIPCL)
Harvesting at the Vastan plant (Credit: GIPCL)

sites.name: 1 MW GSECL STPS Solar, Sikka
sites.crops: Okra, bottle gourd, coriander, cluster beans; winter: tomato, cucumber, zucchini, chilli; summer: moong
specs: PPA with GUVNL at ₹3.22/kWh for 20 years (+₹0.05/kWh steps); ₹5.75 Cr/MWp; OPEX about ₹700/kWp/yr
3 m; underground cabling; 4.5 acre/MWp; module gaps 25/150/250 mm
Wet cleaning every 7–8 days (2–5 L/module) because of cement dust nearby
Gritty sandy soil; drip pipes; 5 m³ and 22 m³ tanks
Structure too high for easy cleaning; tilting 20 panels needs ~10 people; drip upkeep
sites.about: Built on GSECL land never farmed before (744 mm rain). Crops are grown between rows and below modules; crops over 5–6 ft can't be grown.

photos.cap: Panel view of the 1 MW Sikka plant

sites.name: 1 MW Agri Base Solar Power Plant, Pandhro
sites.crops: Brinjal, cluster beans, coriander, okra, bottle gourd; green gram, sesame, black gram, zucchini, peas
specs: PPA with PGVCL at ₹3.22/kWh for 20 years
Same as the Sikka sister plant
Cleaning water from the grid pipeline, panel theft, structure too high for easy cleaning
sites.about: Arid mining district with 355–375 mm of rain; mirrors the Sikka plant.

photos.cap: Harsha Abakus 1 MW Pandhro plant (Credit: Harsha Abakus)

sites.name: Abellon Energy plant, Aravalli
sites.crops: Bottle gourd, okra, watermelon, turmeric, ginger, chilli
specs: Feed-in tariff under the Gujarat Solar Policy
Manual; cleaning water irrigates the crops; cotton fibre keeps soil moist
Henna hedge around the plant as a windbreak
sites.about: Semi-arid Aravalli foothills (690 mm rain); cleaning water directly irrigates the interspace crops.

sites.name: Agrivoltaics plant near Nashik (Sahyadri Farms)
sites.dev: SunSeed APV, Kanoda Energy and GIZ
sites.crops: Grapes, oranges, raspberry, tomato, strawberry (orchards)
specs: Scorpius and SunSeed APV single-axis tracker
sites.about: Orchard crops under a fully elevated single-axis tracker at a farmer producer company.

photos.cap: Lemon plantation under elevated PV (Credit: GIZ)

sites.name: Clean Solar Pvt. Ltd., Tandur
sites.crops: Lemongrass (main); annatto, brinjal, okra, green chilli, onion
specs: ₹18,000/MWp/yr weeding costs; ₹1.5–2 lakh/ha gross income from lemongrass oil
Thin film 170 Wp and crystalline 310/315 Wp; single-axis and fixed tilt
Loam, sandy loam, sandy clay loam
1 acre; year-round harvest; 60–70 L lemongrass oil; less soil erosion
sites.about: Lemongrass between rows needs little water and suits rainfed conditions.

photos.cap: Tandur plant with seedlings planted (Credit: Mahindra Susten)
Tandur plant with lemongrass (Credit: Mahindra Susten)

sites.name: Jain Irrigation agrivoltaic pilots
sites.crops: Banana, rice, cotton, okra, turmeric, ginger, mint, maize
specs: 14.4 kWp, >5 m, single-axis; banana yield 14–34.5 t/acre (+140%), water −55%
9.6 kWp, 3 m, fixed, drip; rice 3.1–3.8 t/acre (+22.5%), water −33.7%
50.4 kWp, single column, dual-axis tracking, drip
19.3 kWp, semi-transparent glass-glass, stilted 1.7–2.5 m, sprinkler cleaning
200 kWp transparent BIPV roof on a 1,100 m² greenhouse with LED lighting for banana seedlings
sites.about: Jain Irrigation has explored agrivoltaics since 2012 at its Jalgaon R&D farm, first to power farm pumps.

photos.cap: 14.4 kW structure with banana (Credit: Jain Irrigation)
9.6 kW system with rice (Credit: Jain Irrigation)
2-axis tracking with drip irrigation (Credit: Jain Irrigation)

sites.name: Sandhwani Solar Power Plant
sites.crops: Eggplant, cabbage, onion, chilli, okra (for seed); turmeric under panels
specs: PPA with HIMURJA at ₹3.75/kWh for 25 years; ₹1.1 Cr structure cost
2.2 m; 2 m interspace, 4 m between structure bases; underground cable
sites.about: Beneath the Dhauladhar range with about 1,411 mm of rain, so structure and drainage design matter.

photos.cap: Agrivoltaics near Jahu (Credit: Gramin Vikas Trust)

sites.name: Dayalbagh Educational Institute plant
sites.crops: Grams, brinjal, tomato, wheat, spinach, cauliflower, carrot, gourds
specs: Monocrystalline; 50% semi-transparent, 50% regular, in checkerboard and single-type towers
19 towers × 50 modules, 18 ft high, ~3.5 t per column
Single-axis azimuth tracking (up to +20%); mechanical locks against storms
Drip for vegetables; STP water for grams; mulching
Yields reported unchanged; crops below 8 ft; tractors can plough
sites.about: Built on former fodder land at a 1,200-acre campus; students farm the plots.

sites.name: AgriVolta New Tehri
sites.crops: Rosemary and geranium (for hydrosol and essential oil)
specs: Scarce project-specific information; NISE training helped commissioning
sites.about: Rosemary grown under a 200 kW array on 2.5 acres and distilled on site, giving 1.5 acres of overlapping productivity.

sites.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Ujwa Solar Farm
sites.crops: Okra, tomato, brinjal, capsicum, leafy and root vegetables, cole crops
specs: Land: KVK Ujwa; plant: Oakridge Rooftops
Delhi Department of Power; ICAR-ATARI Zone II
30% equity, 70% IREDA debt backed by KfW
Pressure washer every 10 days; gutters drain to an underground tank
BSES grid; shared by NAFED, NHRDF and KVK at ₹3.13/kWh
sites.about: Demonstration on 2,000 m² under Delhi's Mukhyamantri Kisan Aay Badhotri Solar Yojana, funded by Delhi Transco CSR and NABARD.

photos.cap: Aerial view before cultivation (Credit: KVK Ujwa)

sites.name: National Institute of Solar Energy interspace plant
sites.crops: Tomato, chilli, flowers, Kufri Lima potato
sites.about: Experiments growing tomato, chilli and flowers between and beneath ground-mounted arrays.

sites.name: CAZRI plants, Jodhpur
sites.crops: Mungbean, mothbean, clusterbean, isabgol, cumin, chickpea, aloe vera, sonamukhi, sankhpuspi, chilli, cabbage, onion, garlic
specs: 500 kWp/ha; FiT ₹4/kWh; crop net income ₹80,000/ha/yr; ₹57,142/kWp system cost
26° tilt; arrays at 1.22, 1.94 and 2.66 m with 3, 6 and 9 m interspaces
Rainwater harvested off modules: ~1.5 lakh L/yr into a 100 m³ tank
49% of land farmed; LER about 1.41; mungbean unaffected by shade, isabgol and cumin hurt
sites.about: Arid site with 6.11 kWh/m²/day irradiance and nearly 300 clear days a year.

sites.name: Hailakandi Agrivoltaics project
sites.crops: Ashwagandha, roselle, tulsi
specs: Offset energy for a tea processing unit at SS College
Medicinal plants benefit from the panels' rain protection
sites.about: A field model for the northeast in an Aspirational District: herbs grown under the panels are blended into tea at the college unit.

sites.name: Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology
sites.crops: Pineapple and dragon fruit; leafy vegetables in summer
specs: Plasticulture centre, Dept. of Fruits and Vegetables
BEE via the Odisha state nodal agency
Any shade-bearing crop can be grown
sites.about: Demonstrates the model at different structure heights.

sites.name: Fish Pond Agrivoltaics
sites.cap: 30 kW over a fish pond (site total 1 MW)
sites.crops: Fish farming
sites.about: Fish farmed in a pond under PV modules.

photos.cap: Fish pond under PV modules (Credit: Down to Earth)

sites.name: Tata-Cornell Institute community agrivoltaics
sites.dev: Tata-Cornell Institute, Jain Irrigation, NGO PRAN
sites.crops: Ginger, turmeric, gourds, banana, sugarcane, onion, leafy vegetables, potato, maize
specs: 3 irrigation pumps and a wheat mill
Borewells to a retention tank; drip and sprinkler over 8 acres
Group cohesion, adjacent plots, market access, local inputs and technical support decide success
sites.about: Group-owned smallholder site to co-produce food and energy and move farmers out of rice. Part of TCI's Zero-Hunger, Zero-Carbon Food Systems project.

sites.name: Ruvexa pole-mounted agrivoltaics
sites.crops: Rice and wheat
specs: Patented poles with 6 panels each in column clusters
Plot rotated 27° from north–south; independent poles let the array follow the site
sites.about: Installed in IARI's Integrated Farming System rice–wheat section to study shading on crops.

photos.cap: Shadows at different times of day

sites.name: Agritech Innovation Pilot 2.0
sites.crops: Multiple; tall crops possible
specs: Seed Research and Technology Centre, PJTSAU
sites.about: University research field under an elevated structure.

sites.name: Amity University agrivoltaics
sites.crops: Maize, potato, brinjal, mustard
specs: Automatic sprinkler cleaning; runoff irrigates the field
About 90% of land farmable; yields unchanged
sites.about: Overhead cabling and tall poles leave the field open for tractors.

sites.name: Junagadh Agricultural University plant
sites.crops: Tomato, capsicum, cotton
specs: Manual; pipe cleaning with rain gutters tested
Black soil; no tractor; shade and insect nets tested
Local yield comparison with open field for tomato and capsicum
sites.about: JAU recommends this overhead stilted model to Gujarat farmers (827 mm rain).

photos.cap: Junagadh system (Credit: Prof. P.M. Chauhan, JAU)

sites.name: Agrivoltaics on coal ash, Durgapur
sites.crops: Vegetables, flowers, spices, energy crops
specs: Local grid of Durgapur Steel Thermal Power Station
Sprinkler; all water reused for irrigation
Coal ash needs frequent ploughing and crop-specific care
sites.about: Uses fly and bottom ash as topsoil to turn barren land into agrivoltaic farmland.

sites.name: NISE vertical bifacial pilot
sites.crops: N.A.
sites.about: Vertical bifacial modules leave the land between rows free.

photos.cap: Vertical bifacial PV at NISE (Credit: NSEFI)

sites.name: Residential Agrivoltaics Rooftop
sites.crops: Cauliflower, tomato, okra, chilli, pomegranate, lemon, spinach, rosemary, gourd, brinjal, beans, basil, papaya, lettuce
specs: REC 380 Wp mono PERC with Enphase IQ7+ microinverters
Galvanised steel, 2.3 m, walkway; white heat-seal paint raises albedo
Automatic water cleaning; harvested rainwater recycled
About 4,500 kWh/yr: 2,200 used at home, 2,300 sold
sites.about: Rooftop garden under panels; ragi and rice did not grow well.

sites.name: BAIF: Demonstrating Agrivoltaics for Prospering Farmers
sites.crops: Planned: aster, gourds, brinjal, beans, beetroot, cucumber, chilli, cauliflower, coriander, cabbage, carrot, capsicum, garlic, ginger, lettuce, marigold, okra, onion, sunflower, sweet corn, spinach, turmeric, tomato
specs: Maxwell Solar & Wind, Hari Govinda Enterprises, GCEP Solar, Solarth, Mruda Solar, Reyon Solar
Local staff trained with Schneider Electric's entrepreneur network
Campus loads, irrigation and drinking-water pumps, battery banks for street lights and EV charging
TOPCon bifacial, flexible mono PERC, mono PERC
12 designs incl. polyhouse flexi-PV, vertical, dual-axis tracker, seasonal tilt, cattle-shed roof, 9.5 m pitch at 1–2.1 m
Finding EPCs experienced beyond conventional ground mounts is hard
sites.about: Upcoming project demonstrating agrivoltaics and a climate-smart village model across Maharashtra, Telangana and Karnataka.

photos.cap: Vertical panels at the BAIF campus
